title: DBGuardAI fix unit contract (version 1)
description: Contract for a single fix unit: one remediation action on one control, including precheck, apply, verify, and rollback steps.

fix_id.description: Unique identifier for this fix unit.

spec_id.description: The spec_id that this fix addresses. Must match a spec in the spec set.

template_id.description: The approved template to use. Must match template registry format: SET_CONFIG_<setting_name> or REVOKE_<privilege>.

template_version.description: The version of the template. Must match the version in the template registry.

params.description: Parameters to pass to the template during rendering.

prior_state.description: The current state before applying the fix, extracted from the snapshot's pg_settings.

precheck.description: Validation step: confirms the current state matches prior_state and fails the check. precheck.expected_value MUST equal prior_state.value. JSON Schema cannot enforce this constraint dynamically - it must be validated by application code.

apply.description: The SQL to apply the fix.

verify.description: Verification step: confirms the control now passes after the fix.

rollback.description: SQL to restore prior_state. Depends on where the value was set (postgresql.conf vs postgresql.auto.conf).

requires.description: Required action after apply: none (instant), reload, or restart.

prior_state.description: Current value and source location before fix.

source.description: Source of the setting (file, command line, default, environment, etc.).

context.description: pg_settings.context value: 'user', 'superuser', 'backend', 'superuser-backend', 'sighup', 'suicide'. Used to derive requires.

sourcefile.description: Full path to the configuration file (postgresql.conf, postgresql.auto.conf, or NULL for non-file sources).

precheck.description: Validation step: confirms the current state matches prior_state and fails the check.

query.description: The SHOW query for the setting.

verify.description: Verification step: confirms the control now passes after the fix.

spec_check_ref.description: Reference to the spec_id and setting_name this verifies.

expected_value.description: Value that should make the check pass.

query.description: The SHOW query for the setting.

requires.description: Action required after apply. Derived from pg_settings.context.
